description.zh: 上游 gremorie 的真实组件 rx-canvas 在本地沙箱中的实际渲染。
description.en: ReactFlow canvas surface for visual workflows / agent graphs. Pre-configured for pan-on-scroll, drag-selection, and deletable nodes via Backspace/Delete. Wraps @xyflow/react ReactFlow + Background. Rendered from the original source at commit df681ad005bb150a3afa9e8e1b7f167e88da24c7.
